t: The Gardena Water Stop provides a reliable solution for managing water flow during outdoor tasks. Engineered for garden hose systems, it enables swift, leak-free changes of watering tools without needing to return to the tap. The unit automatically halts water flow upon disconnection and resumes when a new attachment is fitted. Featuring Powergrip profile technology, it ensures a strong, stable connection, while soft plastic grooves allow easy removal even with wet hands. This durable fitting is compatible with all leading brands, and frost-proof for year-round use.
b: Powergrip Profile For A Secure Connection
